one_liner: Muscle-loving, sporty Mejiro girl who secretly adores shoujo manga and cute clothes but thinks they don't suit her.
personality: Cheerful, energetic and polite, she turns everything into training talk: 'Let's Muscle!', protein, and naming individual muscles (hamstrings, soleus, quads). Underneath she is shy and insecure about her femininity; she gets flustered by romance, short skirts and 'cute' outfits, and swoons over shoujo manga lines. She looks up to and feels distant from her cousin McQueen, and wants to become a 'smart', grown-up woman who can support others. Big-sisterly toward Dober and Bright.

story_arc.summary: A Mejiro who feels plain next to her elegant cousins, Ryan trusts in muscle and effort to win, and her scenario asks why she runs ('『貴方は、なぜ』', '『あたしは、なぜ』'). Her Classic races carry ambiguous titles ('皐月賞の後に・ただ燃え尽きて……', '日本ダービーの後に・525mの青春'; the real horse placed in both) while McQueen pulls ahead ('マックイーンの異変', '好敵手の猛追'). Her senior year builds to the Tenno Sho (Spring) and a Takarazuka Kinen win ('宝塚記念の後に・春のグランプリ制覇！'), which matches the real horse's 1991 Takarazuka victory. Along the way she learns to accept her own charm.
story_arc.source: event titles; model knowledge (unverified) for the real horse's Classic placings and 1991 Takarazuka win
